purpose: Merged official and curated community sources for task-relevant CPT corpus.

recommended_buckets.notes: Highest-priority operational documentation aligned with workflow decisions.
Local workflow traces and structured execution artifacts from the real task distribution.
Archive metadata and dataset descriptions useful for state/context understanding.
Method papers and highly task-relevant cryo-EM literature.
High-value GitHub official/community repositories with strong operational documentation.
Public training pages, user guides, and workshop-style materials.

sources.name: CryoSPARC Guide
sources.why_useful: Directly aligned with cryoSPARC job semantics, workflow structure, and task vocabulary.
sources.acquisition_hint: Mirror or export the relevant guide pages into text or markdown snapshots with URL provenance.

sources.name: CryoSPARC Live Documentation
recommended_sections: New Live Session: Start to Finish Guide
sources.why_useful: Covers real-time monitoring, session state, and operational decision points close to agent behavior.
sources.acquisition_hint: Collect page snapshots plus any available tutorial transcripts or notes.

sources.name: RELION Documentation
sources.why_useful: Adds general cryo-EM workflow knowledge and supports future multi-tool expansion.
sources.acquisition_hint: Export tutorial and reference pages as markdown or cleaned text with section metadata.

sources.name: cryoDRGN Documentation and Repository
sources.why_useful: Adds reconstruction-tool concepts relevant to future tool generalization.
sources.acquisition_hint: Collect README, docs pages, example workflows, and command help text.

sources.name: EMPIAR Archive, Talks, and Tutorials
sources.why_useful: Improves dataset-level understanding, archive conventions, and EMPIAR/EMDB context mapping.
sources.acquisition_hint: Capture tutorial pages and archive metadata descriptions with source URLs.

sources.name: Local workflow and log artifacts
sources.why_useful: Best match to the actual downstream task and deployment environment.
sources.acquisition_hint: Convert to normalized text-plus-metadata records for CPT bucket mixing.

sources.name: Filtered cryo-EM method papers
sources.why_useful: Can provide additional method and parameter priors once irrelevant papers are removed.
sources.acquisition_hint: Use the relevance filter script before adding paper chunks to the CPT mix.

sources.name: RELION GitHub repository
sources.why_useful: Core software repo with versioned README, installation cues, and implementation-facing context.

sources.name: RELION documentation repository
sources.why_useful: Repository that backs RELION documentation and contains reference/developer-oriented docs.

sources.name: Topaz GitHub repository
sources.why_useful: High-value particle-picking documentation and CLI examples relevant to cryo-EM preprocessing.

sources.name: nextPYP GitHub repository
sources.why_useful: Pipeline-oriented cryo-EM processing repo with practical workflow and automation context.

sources.name: Scipion user documentation and facilities guides
sources.why_useful: Structured public user guides and facilities/tutorial pages with practical EM workflow content.

sources.name: TeamTomo site
sources.why_useful: Community knowledge site with curated algorithmic and IO package content for tomography workflows.
